mechanism: Febuxostat is metabolized by CYP450 enzymes (primarily CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP3A4) and fluphenazine inhibits multiple CYP450 pathways, potentially increasing febuxostat concentrations and uric acid-lowering effects.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels and febuxostat efficacy; consider alternative antipsychotic or adjust febuxostat dosing if significant interaction is suspected; baseline and periodic liver function tests are recommended.
